integrity: Exact Hilbert-space extremal and finite checker are given; no independent audit or external certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Results apply to unrestricted normalized harmonic Poisson maps with normalized L2 boundary norm, not globally sense-preserving subclasses.
Sharp covered schlicht-disk radius and cases p≠2 are not determined.
Older unindexed equivalent theorems remain a residual originality risk.
title: Sharp harmonic Hardy–Hilbert Landau radius and co-Lipschitz profile
